_comment: Site changelog (changelog.html). Newest first. Features and new pages = entries with 1-3 short items (optional link, "shots": [...] — 2+ = carousel). Small changes = {"minor": true, date, category, title, optional link}: listed under the day, folded under a toggle when there are more than 3. Categories: Patch Reader, Materials, Hero Lab, Dynamics, Site. Add an entry in the same commit as the change. "fix": true = a correction of something that was wrong (shown with a pixel beetle).

entries.title: Terrain 7.41: the empty corners beyond the map's edge now show plain ground — grass by Radiant, grey ground by Dire, no copied trees or bushes — instead of a murky fade; the credit line is down to “Inspired by Leamare and devilesk”
Terrain: our own 7.41 map picture
items: The 7.41 map is now our own render, made in Source Filmmaker from the game's files, frame by frame, and stitched by our script
The empty corners beyond the map's edge fade softly into darkness instead of showing patched-in map
Idea and inspiration: Leamare and devilesk, linked under the slider; whatever on a page is still borrowed is named there

Tag filters: a card that shows a filtered change stays, an item with nothing to show is hidden (Witch Blade 7.41 under BUFF left a bare header)

7 disputed tags fixed: HUD timers are QoL, "now levels with" is REWORK, lost targets are DEL
Item before / after cards list every stat, also the unchanged ones (18 cards, e.g. Mage Slayer)
Toggles usable under silence or invisibility are MISC (11 rows)
